mismatch.clean: yet now, if thou wilt forgive their sin—; and if not, blot me, i pray thee, out of thy book which thou hast written.

mismatch.clean: whosoever denieth the son, the same hath not the father: but he that acknowledgeth the son hath the father also.
mismatch.wharton: whosoever denieth the son, the same hath not the father: (but) he that acknowledgeth the son hath the father also.
